title: Barbarians (S.I.C.)
description: This mod adds bandits, barbarians and the like to the game. The mod also adds daggers and a spell to the game.
body:
Information About the Mod:

   Mobs:

   This mod aims to add new mobs to the game. Three different mobs have been added to the game. These mobs are barbarians, bandits and dark wizards. Barbarians have the same appearance as villagers. This makes it difficult to distinguish them. Barbarians make a ranged attack by throwing eggs. They drop an emerald when they die. Another mob added to the game is the bandit. They attack using iron daggers. When bandits die, they drop an iron dagger. Bandits can sometimes attack by shooting arrows. The last mob added to the game is the dark wizards. They look like a villager wearing red clothes. They perform ranged attacks using powerful magic. They can heal themselves. When they die, they drop a stun spell.

   ![Barbarian](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/14613445a1140519f50d71632d15226149d12cd9_0.webp)
   
 Barbarian

 ![Bandit](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/45b658e2bf31e7fa6388e85505062e02ce683a9c_0.webp)

 Bandit

 ![Dark Wizard](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/52a4b6b0db293e405e2927877389a0c5e4158e78_0.webp)

 Dark Wizard

 Weapons and Spells:

 Several types of daggers have been added to the game. You can attack faster using daggers than swords, but daggers deal less damage than swords. Daggers can be crafted at a crafting table. A stun spell has also been added. This spell cannot be crafted and only drops from dark wizards. The spell deals very high damage and burns.

 ![Daggers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd70c0f363990541750dc5a7fea6c095260a1ac0_0.webp)
